page.overview:
Who is ZEXAL 3?

ZEXAL 3, known as ZEXAL Third (ゼアル, Zearu Sādo) in the Japanese version, is a character appearing in Yu-Gi-Oh! Legacy of the Duelist and Yu-Gi-Oh! Legacy of the Duelist: Link Evolution.

He is a video game depiction of ZEXAL III, a fusion between Yuma Tsukumo and Astral, from the Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL anime. Defeating him once in the campaign unlocks his character icon for Deck construction, and defeating him across all appearances unlocks his Challenge Deck.
